title: syntext.json
description: Syntext site configuration (syntext.json, syntext.yml or syntext.yaml).

$schema.description: JSON Schema URL for editor support: https://syntext.dev/schema/syntext.json

projectId.description: Project id, written by stx init. Read by the CLI only.

name.description: Site name in the header, titles and llms.txt.

favicon.description: Favicon URL. Only the string form is used.

github.description: GitHub repository URL for the header link.

locale.description: BCP-47 language tag of the site, e.g. en or ar-EG.

theme.description: Preset (workbench, paper, console, atlas, plain, orbit, grid, margin), a v1 theme (default, gravv), or an organization theme "@org/slug".

appearance.description: Doc engine v2 appearance: overrides the preset named by theme.

accent.description: One accent colour, or one per mode.

toggle.description: Readers can switch light and dark.

header.description: The header bar. Changes the header only: the home, sidebar and components keep the preset's look.

home.description: The docs home layout, one per header style. Default: the preset's own home.

themeOverrides.description: Exact token values, applied after the preset and appearance.

navigation.description: Overrides the folder structure, which is the navigation by default.

api.description: API reference settings (doc engine v2): request sample languages, and the overview sections a spec cannot fill.

requestLanguages.description: Languages of the generated request samples on v2 endpoint pages, in tab order. Default: curl, javascript, python, go, ruby, php, java, csharp. A page's `requestLanguages` frontmatter wins.

limits.description: Column name to limit, e.g. { "Requests per minute": 60 }.

headers.description: Rate-limit response headers. Default: the ones the spec declares.

pagination.description: Default: the parameters of an x-speakeasy-pagination or x-fern-pagination operation.

example.description: A page of results: a string (shown as written) or JSON.

sdks.description: SDK cards: name, install command, link.

baseUrl.description: Base URL for the MCP tool manifest.

tab.description: Header tab this group belongs to (a tabs[].name).

pages.description: Page slugs, relative to the docs root, without extension.
